plan: Three drops separated by two emptyings: the rig rests bright and blue on the four-on-the-floor, and the only two times light truly leaves the room are the two places the measurement says it does — the brightness floor inside the vocal verse at moment 11, and the single beat before the peak at moment 22.

states.why: Intro has no kick, no bass, no drums — synth 0.59 and keys 0.54 only, so sparse, not full. But brightness is 8.1 and mode +0.3, so it rests warm and near the top of drone's range rather than dim.
Kick 0.77, bass 0.70, synth 0.77 — the rhythm section is fully in. Energy 8.9. This is the resting condition of the first drop.
The densest section measured: kick 0.88, drums 0.41, hh 0.33, energy 9.0 — the song's joint maximum. Highest resting level of the first half.

Kick 0.02 and bass 0.03 — the floor is gone. But energy only falls to 7.8 and brightness climbs to 9.0, the song's peak brightness. So this is a filtered breakdown, not a quiet one: pale and bright at a lower level, never dark.
Kick back to 0.80, energy 8.9. The second drop returns to the first drop's blue so the room reads it as the same place.
Kick thins to 0.30 and drums to 0.06 across this span — still driving but visibly emptying toward the vocal section. Rests below section 4 to make that drain legible.

No kick, no bass — the voice and organ carry it (vocal 0.47, organ 0.53). Brightness bottoms at 4.6 here, the song's measured floor, so it rests warm and low. Kept as a wash rather than a drone so the blackout at moment 11 has something to take away.
Same vocal, but hh 0.34 and synth 0.36 have joined and brightness recovers to 7.3. A shade up and a shade brighter than section 6.
Kick 0, synth 0.11, vocal 0.06 — everything is gone except strings, which climb to 0.91. Sparse by measurement, so a drone; indigo because the section is a sustained string pad, not a beat.
Kick returns at 0.28 with synth 0.65 and double-bass 0.63. Half-strength drive rebuilding — rests between the hollow and the drops.

The only minor stretch in the song: mode measures -1.0 here against +0.3 to +0.5 everywhere else. Synth alone at 0.24-0.58 and declining, everything else at zero. Coldest and lowest resting state in the show.

Keys slam back in (0.15 to 0.84 in two seconds), organ to 0.41, and groove hits 10.0 — the song's maximum. Still no kick, so a mid wash, and warm gold because mode has flipped to major; the tint at moment 19 delivers the rig here.
Kick 0.75, bass 0.67, energy 8.9. The final drop, resting at the level of the first two so the finale can go above it.

Thirty seconds of energy pinned at 8.9-9.0 with synth 0.79 and the busiest onsets in the song (4.83/s). The highest resting level anywhere — the finale is a plateau, not a spike, so the state carries it.

bindings.why: Kick measures 0.88 here, the highest of any lane in any section. The room breathing on the four-on-the-floor is the whole point of this section.
Strings are the only thing playing: 0.40 rising to 0.91 at t=140 then back to 0.39, a clean arc, while synth and kick sit at zero. Textbook one-instrument section — the drone alone would waste it.
Synth carries this section by itself (0.53 mean, every other lane under 0.01) and it fades as the section runs. Binding to it means the hollow drains on its own rather than sitting still.
The densest onsets in the song, 4.83/s. Threshold set to 0.3 because mean onset intensity measures 0.268 — the 0.5 default would fire on almost nothing here.

gestures.why: Brightness measures 4.6 at this exit — the lowest value anywhere in the song, against a range topping out at 9.0. The darkest gesture goes at the darkest measured point, not at the loudest one.
The beat before the peak. Brightness measurably dips to 6.7 right at t=221.4 before jumping to 8.5 — the song itself takes the light away first.
The loudest stretch of the song at intensity 1.0. The biggest gesture available, landing out of the blackout a beat before it.
Climax at 1.0, six instrument families at once, and it carries hold_s 15.0 — a sustained plateau, not an instant. A short burst opens it and lets the section state hold the remaining twelve seconds.

Nine instruments leave at once at intensity 1.0 and kick collapses from 0.88 to 0.02. But energy only falls to 7.8, so this is a controlled pull-back into the breakdown, not darkness — a blackout here would contradict the measurement.

Register shift at 1.0, two seconds after the floor drops out. Brightness rises 8.0 to 8.7 and groove to 9.3 while energy falls — the melody climbed as the rhythm left. Lift holds, so the breakdown sits higher than it landed.
Synth enters at 60.18 and the build lands at 64.39 at intensity 0.848. Brightness peaks at 9.0 — the song's maximum — at t=63.94, right inside this span. The riser into the second drop.

Energy falls 8.0 to 6.3 and groove collapses 9.6 to 2.8 across this — the deepest trough of the back half. The label credits lead-vocal, but the lane measures 0.0 until t=102.0, so nothing is spotlit yet: the room empties and waits.
Intensity 1.0, and the lead-vocal lane confirms it — carries_from_s 102.0, peak 1.0. The hook actually arrives here, five seconds after the label at moment 8 said it would. Colour's answer to impact.
The voice returns at intensity 1.0 and energy measurably lifts 7.2 to 8.3 across it. A bloom that falls away, because the section stays kickless — nothing here justifies holding.
Kick measures 0.283 at t=161 and 0.02 at t=162 — the beat genuinely drops away at this instant. Exactly what cut fires on, and small, because intensity is only 0.16.

Register shift at 1.0 inside the minor hollow. Strings bloom 0.05 to 0.36 by t=167 then fall back to 0.13 — a bloom, so a swell. Not a lift: synth is declining here, the music is emptying, not climbing.

The turn of the whole back half. Mode measures -0.59 before this and +0.01 after — the only minor-to-major crossing in the song — and keys and organ arrive within two seconds. A key change for the eye.

Fourteen seconds of kickless riser into the final drop, with groove at its song maximum of 10.0 at the start and the busiest onset second landing exactly on moment 20. Amount rises while the tint crosses colour — two dimensions moving over the same span.
The whole rhythm section arrives here — kick 0 to 0.77. But intensity measures only 0.381 against ten moments at 1.0, so it gets a partial hit, not the rig. Relative scale is the point.
Energy decays 8.3 to 5.1 over the last six seconds while brightness holds at 7.9 and mode rises to +1.0. The drive leaves but the light does not, so the song ends warm and lit rather than dark.
